value.name: promises answer by Wednesday
value.description: Asha tells the agent she will have an answer before three on Wednesday, and the agent accepts without surprise.
evidence: that she would have an answer before three on Wednesday.
The agent read back the request in the flat voice of someone who had said yes to this before and watched the yes expire, and Asha did not correct any of it.

value.name: ends call and sets phone down
value.description: After the call ends, Asha places the phone face down on the counter where it had been warming.
evidence: When the call ended she set the phone face down again on the same square of laminate it had warmed before

value.name: realizes she repeated Friday's mistake
value.description: Asha understands that she has made the same losing bet again, knowingly and in daylight.
evidence: she understood that she had just made the bet she lost on Friday a second time, in daylight, with her eyes open

value.name: hesitates between two calls
value.description: Asha remains at the counter, thinking about the addendum and Claire's number, but chooses not to contact either.
evidence: Asha stayed at the counter with her palm still flat against the back of the phone
She thought about the addendum on the table behind her, the line where Marcus's name was printed under hers, and about Claire's number sitting one screen-tap away, and she did not reach for either.

value.name: buys forty-eight hours
value.description: Asha recognizes that she has gained forty-eight hours and feels the burden of having to use them without changing her mind twice.
evidence: She had bought herself forty-eight hours, and what she felt, standing there, was not relief but the specific weight of having to spend them not deciding twice.

value.name: examines addendum with Marcus's name
value.description: Asha lifts the addendum and studies the printed line with Marcus's name beneath hers.
evidence: After a moment she did move, just enough to lift the addendum off the table and hold it level under the kitchen light.
Marcus's name was printed in the small block beneath hers, the line under it still blank
